notes.title: Underworld Explorers
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that we are working on a new roguelike game!

Journey into the unknown with Underworld Explorers, a bite-sized roguelike with card and dice mechanics where you will fight powerful monsters, level up your heroes, find artifacts and explore deeper until you confront the Underworld Lord!

You can wishlist the game now here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2956510/Underworld_Explorers/?utm_source=crosspost_steam

notes.title: Update v1.2.0 ~ Controller Support!
notes.notes:
With this update we added controller support for the game! Although the control of the character is done using only two buttons, controller integration has required an effort to replace the mouse functionality,  for example to check the tooltips of other cards or your current artifacts, but we are happy with the result!

If you have any feedback about controller support or something is not working as intended, let us know about it!

Kiko

v1.2.0
[list]
[*] Feature: Added Controller support.
[*] Translation: Added missing skills in spanish.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v1.1.2 ~ Frozen Update!
notes.notes:
This update is focused on the frozen altered status. Its effect has been diminished and we introduced five new artifacts and two skills that synergize with it. We hope that with this changes you show some love to the Snowland biome!

v1.1.2
[list]
[*] Balancing: Impact of the frozen altered status has been reduced. From now on, the number of frozen artifacts is equal to your frozen points.
[*] New Content: 5 new artifacts, one for each biome and all related to the Frozen altered status.
[*] New Content: 2 new skills, both related to the Frozen altered status.
[*] Fix: Improved the Japanese translation of the Daily Dungeon Mode.
[/list]

We are working on more stuff, more news soon. As always, let us know your feedback!

Kiko

notes.title: New Game Mode! Update v1.1.0 ~ Daily Dungeon Mode
notes.notes:
Hello!

For this update, we have a new game mode: the Daily Dungeon Mode! There is available a new Dungeon each 24 hours, with three randomly selected modifiers. There are also 4 new achivements that you will unlock winning runs in the Daily Dungeon Mode :)

We are working on a Ledearbord for the Elemental Dungeon and Daily Dungeon Mode and also on controller support and keeping on eye on some balance stuff.

Kiko

[*] Fix: Tooltips in the Collection Section could be bugged when you returned to the main menu.

notes.title: Future Content - And Thank you!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are very happy about the reception that Right and Down has had since the launch. We currently have a Very Positive rating with more than 60 reviews!

First of all, we want to give all of you a very big thank you. As some of you already know, we are a very small team (my sistemer Maribel, and I, Kiko) so your support means everything to us and help us to continue adding new content to the game!

Talking about new content, we are currently working on a new "Daily Dungeon" mode. It's (relatively) easy to implement, and it will add a lot to the replayability for the game. The idea is that for each daily run there will be some random modifiers (some from the current levels and some new that we are working on right now), and once the mode is working, it's really easy to implement new modifiers that we design in the future!

In addition to this, we are working on controller support for the game and will get the game verified for Steam Deck after that.

I watch all the gameplay videos and streams that I find about the game, and I am also reading all the feedback on our discord server / reviews / steam forums. If you find something that is not working or want to give us your opinion on something, please feel free to do it.

Remember that you can join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/9WFeZFy4Fm]discord[/url]!

Thank you,
Kiko

notes.notes:
We are very happy with the response that the Right and Demo Steam Fest demo has had!

As a very small indie studio (we are only two people making this game, my sister Maribel and me, Kiko!) all this feedback and positive reaction for the game helps us a lot and encourages us to continue with the development of the game!

We also contacted with some YouTubers and streamers, and it was really cool to watch some gameplay videos! Here you can check Retromation playing the game:

notes.title: Devlog: Ready for the Steam Fest!
notes.notes:
This week we have finished adding all the content of the game:

[list]
[*] 6 different characters (1 starting character, 5 unlockable). Each one will have 3 different starting artifacts and 2 skills to choose.
[*] Over 100 artifacts, many of which you will unlock playing the game.
[*] 30 different skills.
[*] 9 unlockable dungeons. You will unlock a new now each time you win a run!
[/list]

We have also added a perk system, so that as you unlock more complicated dungeons you also have a small bonus to choose from before starting the game, giving the game an extra strategy layer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42491010/3d559c110610017a48ffbe768222548cef867d88.jpg[/img]

We have also been working on fixing some bugs and balancing some things with the feedback of people that played the previous demo, so you can play now the demo for the Steam Fest! We hope that you enjoy it and look forward to your feedback!

Kiko

notes.title: Devlog: New Unlockable Dungeons!
notes.notes:
This week we have working on one of the game's progression systems: unlocking new dungeons! You will be able to play 9 different dungeons in the final game.  Every time you win a run, you will unlock the next Dungeon. The first dungeon will be the one available on the demo, remember that you can play it now!

Each new dungeon will add new rules to the games (added to the previous ones!) so the game will be more complex and interesting each time you win a run.

For example, we have this dungeon that adds padlock cards, key cards, and a new resource, keys. From now on, in order to move to a padlock card you will need to use a key. In this way we add one more resource that the player has to manage, and the fact that he has to make tactical decisions about spending the keys since the padlocks will condition the best routes to follow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42491010/50ad65a8c6733afe89ebea3033c056b17666bdde.jpg[/img]

Another of the new dungeons will add bosses. Every ten levels, you will have to face a boss from the biome you are in at that moment. Our objective with the design has been to try to make a small puzzle with each one. For example, for the boss of the Volcano biome, the more points you have in the Burned altered status, the less damage the boss will do to you, so you will have to decide to what extent it pays you to pick up traps that increase that negative status so in exchange to receive less damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42491010/0898b98e2fc1545ec74421ecd9d857953730fab2.jpg[/img]

Remember that you can play the demo right now (but only the first Dungeon!).

Kiko

notes.title: Devlog: New Characters!
notes.notes:
This week we have been adding and testing new characters. Our objective is that  the starting abilities and artifacts for each character feel different enough to change the way you approach each run.

In addition to the characters we already had in the demo, we have added:

Shaman. Her main characteristic is that she is immune to poison, and her artifacts and abilities reinforce this. The idea is that she is a character that tries to go to the Forest Biome where she can get more artifacts that have synergy with being poisoned.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42491010/57e49a52581f4390dfc194f8aa2173b03770aa4b.jpg[/img]

Dwarf Engineer. This character will have skills and artifacts related to the use of money. The main goal is that the player has to make the decision of when and how to spend money on their skills and artifacts, in addition to the usual use of buying artifacts.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42491010/b17bb5ed5b4fbf77f821c9757f0ceeda0ca8a48d.jpg[/img]

Black Wizard. This character will add a randomness factor to the gameplay. For example, his starting ability has a 50% chance of dealing damage to enemies and 50% of chance of healing them. His artifact adds a card that when picked up deals damage to the player or all enemies. So with this, you have to take chance into account and use it in your favor!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42491010/961a56ec11388ff777612b835b5fe8e51945d523.jpg[/img]

In addition to this, for the final game all characters will have 3 artifacts and 2 abilities to choose from at the beginning, so you will be able to customize each run!

Remember that you can try the demo!

Kiko
